title: Game On: How Sports Shape Military Leaders
intro: Marines are built to fight and win—and that warrior mindset doesn't stop after hours. Whether it's on the court, field, or screen, intramural sports and esports offer powerful ways to stay sharp, connected, and mission-ready.

sections.heading: Build Skills That Translate to the Mission
sections.markdown:
From basketball and flag football to soccer and softball, intramural sports develop leadership, teamwork, and quick decision-making—skills that mirror the demands of combat and high-pressure situations.

Esports, or competitive video gaming, may look different, but the mission is the same: think fast, communicate clearly, and execute with precision. These cognitive skills are vital both in training and real-world operations.

sections.heading: Everyone Has a Place on the Team
sections.markdown: Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just getting started, there's a team for you. Intramural leagues and esports are open to all Marines, offering fun ways to build camaraderie, relieve stress, and strengthen unit cohesion.

sections.heading: Get in the Game
sections.markdown: Visit your local [Semper Fit](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/recreation) or MCCS Sports Office to join an intramural or esports league today. Your next team is waiting—on the field or in the game.
